fields.summary_ko.0: TSM rose 33.2% last year, significantly outpacing semiconductor sector gains of 6.8%, compared to GFS up 17.5% and UMC up 112.7%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 2026 revenue of $46.72 billion (up 41.2% year-over-year), net profit increased 68.7%, with high-performance computing (HPC) revenue up 22% quarter-over-quarter representing 68% of total revenue.
fields.summary_ko.2: 2026-2028 capex expected to substantially exceed prior three-year levels, with 7-nanometer and below advanced processes representing 79% of wafer revenue and 2-nanometer technology expanding from 3% to 8% per quarter.
